entities.summary: Ethel Louise Spowers was an Australian artist associated with the Grosvenor School of Modern Art in London. She was especially known for her linocuts, which are included in the collections of major Australian and British Art Galleries. She was also a founder of the Contemporary Art Society, promoting modern art in Australia. Ethel Spowers was a painters & sculptors from Melbourne (1890-07-11, Melbourne–1947-05-05). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
